item.title: Daily News for Tuesday, July 7, 2026
item.description: Today's throughline is AI accountability moving from theory to consequence — and that's your lane. British Columbia is exploring legal action against OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge tragedy, which is the sharpest possible signal that public bodies now treat AI vendors as liable act...
